rankings.title: ‘Super’ El Niño could cause 239,000 additional heat deaths by February 2027; India may see 15,800: Report
rankings.india_relevance: This report quantifies the severe potential human impact of a 'super' El Niño event on India, especially concerning heat-related mortalities.
rankings.why_it_matters: Beyond direct health impacts, extreme weather events like El Niño can disrupt agriculture, water resources, and labor productivity, posing significant economic and social challenges for India.
